candidate_sentence_map.S1: Ambu reported a solid start to the 2025/26 financial year, with Q1 revenue increasing to DKK 1,558m from DKK 1,510m.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Organic growth was 8.6%, compared with 19.5% in Q1 2024/25, while reported growth was 3.2%, reflecting a 5.4% negative currency impact.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Growth was led by Endoscopy Solutions, supported by rising procedure volumes, continued adoption of single-use endoscopy and market expansion.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Endoscopy Solutions grew organically by 14.4%, compared with 20.6% in the prior-year quarter, and accounted for 63% of total revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Urology, ENT, & GI was the strongest business group, with organic growth of 21.0%, primarily driven by continued penetration of the aScope 4 portfolio and strong momentum for aScope 5 Uretero.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Respiratory grew 8.3%, supported by bronchoscopy solutions, aScope 5 adoption and the launch of the SureSight video laryngoscope solution.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Anesthesia & Patient Monitoring recorded flat organic growth of -0.1%, compared with 17.8% last year, as both Anesthesia and Patient Monitoring faced an exceptionally high comparable revenue base.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: North America and Europe delivered organic growth of 9.8% and 9.7%, respectively.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Rest of World declined 1.6% organically because of order fluctuations and high comparable revenue from the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: EBIT before special items fell to DKK 164m from DKK 243m, reducing the EBIT margin from 16.1% to 10.5%.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: EBITDA before special items decreased to DKK 261m from DKK 331m, and the EBITDA margin declined from 21.9% to 16.8%.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The EBIT margin was negatively affected by tariff costs of more than DKK 50m and foreign-exchange headwinds; excluding these factors, Ambu reported an EBIT margin of 15.2%.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The gross margin was broadly stable at 60.8%, down from 61.3%, while the operating-expense ratio increased to 50.3% from 45.2% as Ambu continued investing in commercial infrastructure and absorbed tariff costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Profit before tax decreased to DKK 153m from DKK 237m, and net profit fell to DKK 118m from DKK 183m.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Free cash flow before acquisitions declined to DKK 13m from DKK 69m, mainly because of lower EBITDA, elevated working capital, foreign-exchange effects and tariffs.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Ambu launched its ZOOM AHEAD strategy and introduced the portable SureSight Mobile video laryngoscope.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: The company maintained its full-year guidance for 10–13% organic revenue growth, a 12–14% EBIT margin before special items and cash conversion above 40%; excluding the expected tariff impact, the EBIT margin target is 14–16%.
